items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: The disc jack, WBOK. Okie Dokey.

ctx.x: The other voice in there is Johnny Adams? Yeah, that's Johnny Adams.

So Johnny and I did this. Oh, it's a heck of a record. Now, what is his name? The disc jack, WBOK. Okie Dokey. Okie Dokey. Yeah. No, not Okie Dokey. What the other? That would have been earlier. Yeah, not Okie Dokey.
